channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Bitdeer AI converted another Malaysia shell into an executed deal: an 8-year data center services agreement for A103, a 60 MW (critical IT load) AI Cloud facility on its existing Cyberjaya campus alongside A101 and A102, designed for liquid-cooled NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks with energization aimed at Q1 2028. Campus AI Cloud capacity is expected to reach about 71.5 MW; Bitdeer's secured capacity rises to about 333.5 MW (about 95% of its up-to-350 MW target). No A103 offtake is disclosed yet. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print confirmed yesterday's levels: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Separately, Enerflex said it won over 1 GW of behind-the-meter natural-gas generation for a large North American data center (backlog now over 1.75 GW through 2028), and Fermi signed AMD credit support tied to its 222 MW Project Matador phase-one lease in Texas.

item.title: Compute brief - 13 October 2026
item.description: Bitdeer AI converted another Malaysia shell into an executed deal: an 8-year data center services agreement for A103, a 60 MW (critical IT load) AI Cloud facility on its existing Cyberjaya campus alongside A101 and A102, designed for liquid-cooled NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks with energization aimed at Q1 2028. Campus AI Cloud capacity is expected to reach about 71.5 MW; Bitdeer's secured capacity rises to about 333.5 MW (about 95% of its up-to-350 MW target). No A103 offtake is disclosed yet. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print confirmed yesterday's levels: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Separately, Enerflex said it won over 1 GW of behind-the-meter natural-gas generation for a large North American data center (backlog now over 1.75 GW through 2028), and Fermi signed AMD credit support tied to its 222 MW Project Matador phase-one lease in Texas. Countries: Malaysia: Bitdeer AI 8-year DCA for A103, 60 MW critical IT at Cyberjaya; campus to about 71.5 MW; secured capacity about 333.5 MW; energization Q1 2028; no offtake disclosed (Wire, 12 Oct). United States / PJM: FERC ER26-3515 registry effective 12 Oct still the binding US large-load rule of the week; PJM compliance filing due within 30 days of 9 Oct (Wire). Finland: Sesterce Kaipola, Jamsa: EUR 10bn-plus plan, 200 MW then 600 MW, signed unnamed AI-lab anchor; site purchase and permits pending (Wire, 8 Oct). Netherlands: Nebius LOI for capacity at Volt's planned Rotterdam AI campus (developer ambition up to 600 MW; phase one two 100 MW buildings). Letter of intent only (Signal). United States / North America: Enerflex awards over 1 GW behind-the-meter natural-gas generation for an unnamed large-scale North American data center; BTM backlog over 1.75 GW through 2028 (Signal, 13 Oct).
